مُجَهِّزٌ One who sends forth traders with excellent goods: or who travels with such goods. (Mgh.) Hence, app., the vulgar term ↓ مُجَاهِزٌ , meaning A rich merchant. (Mgh.) ―
-b2- And مُجَهِّزُونَ Travelling-companions who assist one in the loading of the beasts. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
